        return 1

        return n * factorial(n: n - 1)

eligible(score: number, active: number) =>
    where score >= 70 and active == 1.0
    return true
else
    return false

eligible(score: number, vip: number) =>
    where score >= 70 or vip == 1.0
    return true
else
    return false

canEnroll(age: number, hasPrereq: number) =>
    where age >= 18
    where hasPrereq == 1.0
    return true
else
    return false

isAdult(age: number) =>
    where age >= 18
    return true
else
    return false
canEnroll(age: number) =>
    where isAdult(age: age) == true
    return true
else
    return false
